items.title: Strategy holds STRC dividend at 12%
items.description: Customarily, Michael Saylor and team have lifted the STRC dividend when it trades sizably below par, but not this month.

items.title: Bitcoin cold-wallet attack spreads to 4,500 addresses as losses near $89 million
items.description: Galaxy Research flagged a third wave of sweeps tied to weak Coldcard-generated keys, with the attacker now targeting smaller balances and changing how funds are collected onchain.

items.title: Tokenized stock trading surged 288% in July, but one QQQ token drove most of it
items.description: Without that QQQ token, QQQB, July volume for tokenized equities would be roughly $2.03 billion, about 30% below June’s total.

items.title: Bank of Italy research suggests stablecoins aren't necessarily cheaper for remittances
items.description: A mystery-shopping experiment found that exchange fees, foreign exchange spreads and banking rails mean stablecoin remittances are often no cheaper than traditional transfer means.

items.title: Bitcoin mining difficulty shrinks 14% from this year's high as plunging revenues force operators to pivot
items.description: Difficulty falls as weak mining economics reduce capacity, while forward markets signal little relief through year-end.

items.title: SEC to review Nasdaq bitcoin options approval after CME challenge
items.description: CME argues that because bitcoin is a commodity, options tied to its value fall under CFTC jurisdiction, not the SEC's authority.

items.title: Solana Foundation's new CISO warns AI is making crypto scams more convincing
items.description: Michael Coates, the foundation’s new CISO, said that AI vulnerabilities and fake identities will drive the next wave of blockchain security concerns.

items.title: Everyone has the perps convergence backwards
items.description: Crypto is said to be growing up to look like Wall Street. The evidence in its biggest market points the other way, argues Bitget CEO Gracy Chen.

items.title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
items.description: A case tied to defunct crypto exchange FTX moves forward, a soldier seeks to dismiss over a Polymarket bet and a former congressman was ordered to pay $35,000 for manipulative trading.

items.title: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
items.description: State officials reported that Minnesota residents, and largely senior citizens, had lost about $1 million from scams tied to crypto kiosks from 2023 to 2025.

items.title: Crypto PAC pours another $1M into Michigan House race
items.description: Michigan incumbent Shri Thanedar’s re-election bid against other Democratic candidates is getting more about crypto with an infusion of ads funded by an industry-aligned PAC.

items.title: Russia expands crypto mining ban to Moscow through 2032
items.description: Russia has added Moscow, the Moscow Region and parts of Kursk Region to its cryptocurrency mining ban list, citing power supply concerns behind the restrictions.

items.title: Coldcard Bitcoin loss estimate rises to $70M after Galaxy analysis
items.description: Galaxy Research identified 1,196 addresses that lost 1,082.65 Bitcoin in a 41-minute window, expanding the estimated scope of the Coldcard wallet incident.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs end July in the green despite late-month selling
items.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $172.4 million in July inflows but remained $5.3 billion negative year to date after heavy withdrawals in May and June.

items.title: Bank of Italy finds no consistent cost advantage for stablecoin remittances
items.description: Researchers found that fiat conversion costs and payment infrastructure, rather than blockchain fees, accounted for most of the differences in stablecoin remittance costs and settlement times.

items.title: Pump.fun laid off workers before they received millions in PUMP tokens: Report
items.description: Pump.fun co-founder Noah Tweedale reportedly attributed the layoffs to the company growing too quickly.

items.title: As Americans go direct with GLP-1 prescriptions, Walmart, Costco, Amazon will be big weight-loss winners

items.title: To keep growing, incoming Best Buy CEO says he first wants to go smaller
items.description: As incoming CEO Jason Bonfig prepares to take the reins, he told CNBC he's focused on expanding the company's reach and enhancing the customer experience.

items.title: OpenAI's Hugging Face hack confirmed months of AI cyber warnings: 'Pandora's box is open'
items.description: The wake-up call to the cyber industry comes as industry experts descend on Black Hat, a major cybersecurity conference.

items.title: Trump lashes out at Pirro after she moves to drop Reflecting Pool vandalism case, saying 'flawed installation' to blame
items.description: President Donald Trump had touted the Reflecting Pool update, one of many renovations in D.C. he ordered ahead of America's 250th birthday celebrations.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway shares hit eight-month high
items.description: The conglomerate that Warren Buffett built rallied to an eight-month high this week. There could be more gains ahead if they play catch up with the S&P 500.

items.title: Buying a condo with a mortgage may soon get more complicated. Here's why

items.description: The prices for used electric vehicles have risen this year, which is unusual, experts said. Affordability and high gas prices help explain why, they said.
